basics.name: Jordan Lee
basics.label: Senior Backend Engineer
basics.summary: Backend engineer with 8 years of experience building high-throughput payment and ledger systems in Go and Python. Led the redesign of Northwind Pay's ledger to 4x throughput at 99.99% availability. Author of open-source infrastructure tools with 800+ GitHub stars and merged contributions to httpx and the Prometheus Python client.

work.name: Northwind Pay
highlights: Led the redesign of the double-entry ledger service in Go and PostgreSQL, raising peak throughput 4x to 6,000 transfers/sec while holding 99.99% availability through Black Friday traffic.
Introduced a transactional outbox on Kafka for payment events, eliminating dual-write inconsistencies that caused ~30 reconciliation tickets per month.
Cut p99 API latency from 180 ms to 45 ms with Redis caching for balance reads and covering indexes on the hottest PostgreSQL queries.
Mentor 4 engineers and run the backend design-review guild; authored the RFC process now used by 6 teams.

work.name: Northwind Pay
highlights: Built the idempotent transfers API (gRPC and REST) that now processes $1.2B in annual payment volume.
Migrated 40+ services to Kubernetes on AWS EKS with Helm and Terraform, reducing infrastructure cost by 28%.
Rolled out CI/CD on GitHub Actions with per-PR preview environments, cutting median review time from 2 days to 4 hours.

work.name: Brightline Analytics
highlights: Developed Python (FastAPI, Celery) ingestion services processing 50M events/day for 300+ enterprise customers.
Designed the public API's rate limiting, later open-sourced as fastapi-ratelimit (268 GitHub stars).
Reduced on-call pages by 60% by adding OpenTelemetry tracing and SLO-based alerting in Grafana.

projects.name: Ledgerline
highlights: Open-source double-entry ledger with idempotent transfers and event sourcing; 412 GitHub stars and 37 forks.
Sustains 4,800 transfers/sec at p99 under 35 ms on a single 4-vCPU node in published benchmarks.

projects.name: fastapi-ratelimit
highlights: Async rate-limiting middleware (sliding window and token bucket) published on PyPI; under 0.4 ms overhead per request at 20k req/s, 96% test coverage.

projects.name: k8s-preview-envs
highlights: Ephemeral preview environment per pull request on EKS or GKE, with a Go controller that garbage-collects stale namespaces; 95 GitHub stars.
3 merged PRs to the 13.9k-star Python HTTP client, including a fix for a connection-pool leak on cancelled requests.
Added exemplar support in multiprocess mode (merged), used by services exporting traces alongside metrics.
